name: @pipeworx/mcp-nih-reporter

tools.name: search_grants
tools.description: Search NIH-funded research projects. Filter by free-text query (topic/subject matter — matches title/abstract/terms, NOT the awardee), PI name, organization (the funded company/university/institution — use THIS, not query, for "what grants has <company/university> received"), fiscal year, US state, or NIH institute code (NCI, NHLBI, NIAID, etc.). Returns project number, PI, institution, fiscal year, award amount, and abstract preview.

query.description: Free-text search over project title/abstract/terms — an AND match on the SUBJECT MATTER words you pass (e.g. "cancer immunotherapy"), not a lookup by funding recipient. Do NOT put a company, institution, or organization name here: the name rarely appears verbatim in grant text, so it instead AND-matches on the name's individual common words and can return thousands of unrelated grants. For "what NIH grants has <company/university/institution> received", use `organization` instead.

pi_name.description: PI last name (or any name part)

organization.description: The funded organization — the company, university, hospital, or institution that RECEIVED the award (e.g., "Stanford University"). This is the correct filter whenever the question names a specific organization/company/institution as the funding recipient — use it INSTEAD of `query`, which searches grant CONTENT, not the awardee.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch one NIH project application record by application ID (numeric, distinct from project number). Returns its complete abstract, public-health relevance, terms, PIs, organization, dates, and award amount. Use nih_grant_award_history for multi-year award history.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search publications acknowledging NIH funding. Filter by PMID, application ID, or core project number. Useful for "what came out of this grant" follow-ups.

tools.name: nih_grant_award_history
tools.description: Build the annual NIH award history for one core project number, including award, direct/indirect cost, budget dates, application type, and cumulative reported funding. Annual award amounts are obligations for each fiscal year—not company revenue, cash received, or guaranteed future funding.

core_project_num.description: Core project number, e.g. R43GM128494 or UG1HD078437.

tools.name: nih_new_grant_awards
tools.description: Find recently issued NIH awards, optionally restricted to new competing applications, topic, organization, state, institute, activity code, or SBIR/STTR. Useful for financing and emerging-program monitoring; an award notice does not establish commercial validation or future funding.

query.description: Topic text across title, abstract, and terms.

activity_code.description: NIH activity code such as R01, R43, or U01.

tools.name: nih_funding_concentration
tools.description: Summarize NIH award dollars and record counts by fiscal year, recipient organization, contact PI, activity code, and funding mechanism for a bounded topic, organization, or PI search. Results disclose truncation and represent reported federal obligations—not valuation, revenue, or total research spending.

tools.name: nih_sbir_company_portfolio
tools.description: Summarize an organization’s NIH SBIR/STTR award portfolio by core project, fiscal year, activity code, and PI. Organization matching is wildcard-based; verify recipient identity and note that reported award amounts are federal obligations, not revenue or unrestricted cash.

organization.description: Recipient organization name or distinctive fragment.

tools.name: nih_funding_expirations
tools.description: Find active NIH projects matching a topic or organization whose current project period is scheduled to end soon. Treat the end date as a monitoring cue only—it can be extended, renewed, supplemented, or updated and does not prove a funding cliff.

tools.name: nih_grant_publication_summary
tools.description: Count publications linked by NIH RePORTER to a core project number and return a bounded PMID sample. Publication linkage reflects acknowledged grant support; it is not a citation-impact, product-readiness, or causal-attribution measure.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nih-reporter forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nih-reporter pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
